plugin-spell-check.name: Spell Check
plugin-spell-check.description: Suggests spelling fixes for searches with Yandex Speller, without holding searches up.

language.label: Language
language.description: Language code passed to Yandex Speller (en, ru, uk).

timeBudgetMs.label: Time budget (ms)
timeBudgetMs.description: How long the suggestion waits for Yandex once results are in. 0 shows it only when Yandex has already answered.
